title: 二叉树展开为链表
statement:
给定二叉树的根节点 root，原地将其展开为一条“链表”：仍使用 TreeNode，每个节点的 right 指向链表中的下一个节点，left 一律置为 nullptr，且节点顺序与原树的先序遍历（根 → 左 → 右）一致。函数无返回值，判题时输出展开后的 root。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输入输出中的树均为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位（展开后形如 1 null 2 null 3 ...）。

en.title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
en.statement:
Given the root of a binary tree, flatten it in place into a "linked list": still using TreeNode, each node's right points to the next node in the list, every left is set to nullptr, and the node order matches the original tree's preorder traversal (root → left → right). The function returns nothing; the judge outputs the flattened root.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. Trees in input and output use LeetCode level-order representation, with null marking empty positions (a flattened tree looks like 1 null 2 null 3 ...).
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 2000]; -100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: O(1) extra space (find the rightmost node of the left subtree and splice, Morris-style); recursive or stack-based versions use O(h)/O(n).
complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up asks to flatten in place using only O(1) extra space.
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes and h is the tree height. In the O(1) solution each edge is walked at most one extra time, so total time is still O(n). The largest local test is a random 2000-node tree, plus a 2000-node left chain (which becomes a right chain after flattening).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m (the number of level-order tokens, 0 for an empty tree); line 2 has m tokens (integers or null), the tree's LeetCode level-order representation. stdout: one line with the flattened tree's level-order tokens (of the form v1 null v2 null v3 …, trailing nulls omitted; an empty line for an empty tree).

constraints: 节点数在 [0, 2000] 范围内；-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（寻找左子树最右节点并拼接，Morris 思路）；递归或栈实现为 O(h)/O(n)。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up 要求原地展开且只用 O(1) 额外空间。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，h 为树高。O(1) 解法中每条边至多被额外走一次，总时间仍为 O(n)。本地最大测试为 2000 个节点的随机树，另含 2000 个节点的左单链（展开后为右单链）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m（层序 token 数，空树为 0）；第二行 m 个 token（整数或 null），为树的 LeetCode 层序表示。stdout：一行，展开后树的层序 token（形如 v1 null v2 null v3 …，省略末尾 null；空树输出空行）。
